verdict.rationale: Lium documents programmatic create and terminate: `lium up` with a TTL, `POST /executors/rent-by-spec`, and agents that "rent, connect and remove pods". It also bills per second with no minimum and auto-deletes pods by hours, end time or spend cap, so you pay only while a pod exists. There is no evidence of stop/pause or restart; persistent volumes and 6-hourly backups are only a workaround for preserving state between rentals. Missing for 10: documented stop/pause and restart operations, billing behavior for stopped instances, and independent hands-on corroboration of the lifecycle API.
